products.title: 2020 Angelica
products.body_html: The Angelica is a very special, very limited dessert wine whose history goes back to the start of California winemaking. Angelica was traditionally made by Spanish missionaries who planted Mission grapes throughout the state. Ours come from Deaver Vineyard's 170-year-old vines, one of the oldest Mission plantings in California. The grapes were lightly fermented, fortified, and aged in barrel for over two years. Makes a great gift for a special occasion, or pour it year-round to cap off an evening with friends. Enjoy with a slight chill.

products.title: 2023 Michael Mara Chardonnay
products.body_html: This Chardonnay has been with us since our first vintage in 2010. It comes from the Michael Mara Vineyard in the Sonoma Coast AVA, a rocky, wind-exposed site that gives the wine its minerality and lift. We bring the grapes in whole cluster, press gently, and let the wine ferment naturally in Austrian oak before resting on the lees for 10 months. It's approachable enough for Chardonnay skeptics and interesting enough for longtime fans. Drink it now, or let it age for years.

products.title: Decanter
products.body_html:
“A dramatic silhouette to any tablescape.” Forbes

The Broc Decanter is a beautiful statement piece for casual at-home imbibing meant to accompany the signature Broc glass. Our decanter pairs effortless style with function as it allows wines to open up before serving. Made with substance and handmade touches that make each decanter unique, the decanter is a timeless piece with a light-reflecting form. Try it with the Broc Nero d’Avola.

Product Specifications:
Dimensions: Stands 8" tall x 6" wide. Holds up to 750 ml.
Care Instructions: Hand wash with soap and water. 

Please read our Return Policy before purchasing.

Complete your tablescape with the Broc Decanter + Glass Set. Whether as a set or on its own, our glassware is the perfect stylish gift for someone special or for your own collection. It will be treasured for years and cheers to come.

The Broc Decanter is crafted by a community of friends and local artists. Chris Brockway and Bridget Leary of Broc Cellars visualized the concept and designed it in collaboration with Rafi Ajl, owner of The Long Confidence. The glassware comes to life at Oakland-based Glow Glass Studio, where it is handblown by Alexander Abajian, Evan Kolker, and David Battaglia. Explore Making Glass to see how our Decanter and glasses are crafted.
